STATUS: fail

SUMMARY: A target that is itself a shadow host gets its own shadow contents hidden, because `addShadowPath` adds `target.shadowRoot` and the walk then hides everything in it. Six other probes (three-level nesting, out-of-order cleanup across shadow roots, refcount, sibling host with later content, root option) passed. The `shouldUseInert` criterion has no test that exercises the inert path.

FILES TOUCHED: none (probe file created and deleted; `git status` shows only the three original modified files)

FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Target that is a shadow host loses its internal content. `addShadowPath` adds `element.shadowRoot` for every node on the path, including the target itself, so `walk` hides the target's own shadow children. Reproduced by P1: `expect(innerButton).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden')` → received `aria-hidden="true"`. Light-DOM targets skip their whole subtree via REJECT, so this breaks parity. Fix: do not add the shadow root of a target (or of anything inside a target) to `shadowRoots`.
- [blocking] No test covers the inert path in shadow roots. jsdom has `'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype === false` (reproduced), so `shouldUseInert: true` silently falls back to `aria-hidden`. The "restore everything… shouldUseInert" test passes without ever setting `inert`, so criterion 4's "works with shouldUseInert" is not really tested. Either add a test that stubs `supportsInert` or drop the claim.
- [minor] `shadowRoots` is never pruned, so roots of hosts that were removed stay in the set and keep being observed until cleanup. Not reproduced as a bug; it is a leak-shaped nit.
- [minor] `addShadowPath` only picks up `element.shadowRoot` when the host is already attached at call time. A path host that attaches its shadow root later is not walked. Not reproduced; outside the listed criteria.

CHECKS:
- P1 target is a shadow host, its inner button must stay visible → FAIL (reproduced, see above)
- P2 three levels of shadow nesting, siblings at each level, light sibling, later addition in mid root, cleanup restores → pass
- P3 out-of-order cleanup of two calls with targets in different shadow roots, additions to each root after the first cleanup → pass
- P4 refcount, two calls hide the same shadow sibling; first cleanup keeps it hidden, second restores it → pass
- P5 sibling host with its own shadow root gets hidden, later content in its shadow root is not hidden, cleanup restores host → pass
- P6 root option with a target in a shadow root under `root`; sibling inside the shadow root is hidden and a body-level sibling is not → pass
- Existing test "content added later to target shadow root / enclosing roots / light DOM", "slot path", "slot added later" → read only, assertions look sound
- Flag-off test and `keepVisible` in shadow roots → read only, not probed
- Inert capability check in jsdom → reproduced: `INERT_SUPPORTED=false`, `SIBLING_ARIAHIDDEN=true INERT=undefined`
- Project/triggered checks (nesting, invariants, dependencies): the package.json change adds `@react-stately/flags` to the manifest; I did not verify the yarn.lock update or run `yarn install --immutable` (orchestrator already ran the suite; not in scope of my probes).

OPEN QUESTIONS: Should P1 be fixed in this change, or is the target-as-shadow-host case out of scope for the listed criteria? Should the inert criterion be tested with a stubbed `supportsInert`?
